request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Remove two things only: the one leg in the middle at the back, behind the others, so that exactly three legs remain (left, front and right); and the pointed horn on the left side of the head, leaving a smooth round chrome head. Keep the three other legs, the chrome head, the hot magenta eye lens, the heat-ray arm, the height, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
